title: Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
abstract: arXiv:2611.08478v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper's open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. We release the first 1,000 verified environments. With the world as an evaluation, we found that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass the human researchers 74% of the time. As a record of how AI does science, it contains 6,400 hours of research traces, with every idea, experiment, failure, and success. As a training ground, we are able to raise (+158%) a small model to match

translated_title: Scientist World：为AI科学家培育一个科研成长世界
translated_abstract: AI-科学家已经到来，但一个供他们成长的世界却尚未出现。人类科学家把这个世界视为理所当然，科学文献中积淀了数百年的悬而未决的问题与共享的思想。对AI-科学家而言，这个世界是可读的却不可运行的，因此我们为其构建了Scientist World：让每一篇研究论文都成为一个可执行的环境。我们的自主流水线会提取每篇论文的开放式研究问题，并将其提出的方法复现为基线；进入环境的AI-科学家将以人类作者取得的成果为标准接受评估。我们发布了首批1,000个经过验证的环境。以这个世界作为评测手段，我们发现前沿AI-科学家在74%的情况下已能超越人类研究者。作为AI如何做科学的记录，其中包含6,400小时的研究轨迹，涵盖每一个想法、实验、失败与成功。作为训练场，我们能够将一个小模型的性能提升（+158%）至与……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Scientist World，将每篇研究论文转化为可执行的研究环境，用于评测和训练AI科学家，并发现前沿AI科学家在74%的情况下已能超越人类研究者的成果。
en_tdlr: Scientist World turns each research paper into an executable research environment for evaluating and training AI-Scientists, revealing that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass human researchers 74% of the time.
